branded.why: The Hungarian chocolate-coated curd bar, a national treat since the late 1960s.

about.text: A bar of sweetened túró, a curd filling, coated in a cocoa coating that uses vegetable fat instead of cocoa butter. It was developed in Hungary from a Soviet chocolate-coated curd bar, and first made in Budapest in the late 1960s.
